title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the work done, W = (q^2 / (8 pi epsilon_0)) * (1/R - 1/(R+t)).

title: Electric Field Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the electric field intensity due to the point charge at various distances.

title: Energy Change Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the correct integration process to find the change in electric energy of the system.

title: Use of Gauss' Law
description: Important Criteria: The student should apply Gauss' law correctly to determine the electric field outside the shell.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the energy change calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all necessary factors, such as epsilon_0, are included in the final expression.
